authority.approval_scope: exact reviewed candidate and operation; changed inputs invalidate approval
authority.human_overrides: preserve pause/cancel/resume/reprioritization/reassignment/review controls without erasing mandatory acceptance or capability floors

resolution.requirements: union of all matching common, repository, classification, routing, review and change-specific requirements
resolution.required_flags: logical OR; routing profile uses maximum matching rank
resolution.before_dispatch: reinspect exact owner revision and policy; reverify stale baselines and record resolved acceptance
resolution.legacy_local_runs: explicitly designated limited runs only; omission is never a permissive default for new managed work

common.local_validation_binding: exact candidate head; frozen precommit patch digest requires verified mapping to the final head

mandatory_when: mutable integration with multiple distinct mutable upstream inputs
any matching routing rule or task-class requirement
independent_validation.session: fresh session distinct from implementer; compatible same-family validator permitted
independent_validation.P2: risk-based; cannot waive another mandatory trigger
independent_validation.P3: record by default; cannot waive another mandatory trigger

acceptance_evidence: policy revision and resolved requirements provenance
local validation PASS with commands, results and exact head
approved review of current head with authoritative evidence
fresh native required-check discovery and current-head check results
exact human merge approval and observed merge facts
authoritative attempt settlement and editor exit
common.missing_or_stale_evidence: HOLD; validation with missing evidence is NEEDS-WORK, never PASS

native_ci.unknown_discovery: HOLD; never infer an empty set from absent CI files, missing access or incomplete discovery
native_ci.verified_empty_requirements: empty array only with fresh native evidence for the exact repository and target branch plus explicit bounded owning-repository disposition
native_ci.check_binding: complete authoritative observations at current PR head for every resolved required check

local_validation: documentation and link acceptance for affected content
affected shell, Makefile and dotfile syntax using their actual interpreters/formats
controlled mocks or reproduction meaningful to the change
/usr/bin/make doctor when installed host readiness is relevant; read-only, binaries and versions do not prove authentication
affected Compose configuration validation via inspected scripts/compose wrapper
runtime and worktree-isolation smoke tests only when meaningful to the change and authorized for scoped contained resources
